example.content:
const outsidePoint = { x: 150, y: 40 };
console.log('外部点到边界的最短距离：', eda.sys_Math.distanceToPoint(zone, outsidePoint));

const insidePoint = { x: 50, y: 40 };
console.log('内部点到边界的最短距离：', eda.sys_Math.distanceToPoint(zone, insidePoint));

_source.title: 计算点到多边形边界的最短距离
_source.example.text.0: 1. 定义矩形区域（右边界在 x = 100）
_source.example.text.1: 2. 外部点：到右边界的水平距离为 50
_source.example.text.2: 3. 内部点：在多边形内部时返回 0
_source.example.text.3: 4. 斜向最近边不是正对的那条边时，结果取真实垂线距离
_source.returns: 最短距离，如点在多边形内部则返回 `0`

title: Calculate the shortest distance from a point to the polygon boundary
returns: Shortest distance. If the point is inside the polygon, `0` is returned
